class_id: source mapped from a field the payload never carries (sector)
symptom: `ipos.sector` was '' on every row (0/251 -> 0/313) because the matrix listed NSE/BSE/MONEYCONTROL/CHITTORGARH as sources for a field none of them actually wrote — NSE read `data.sector`, a key the real payload never carries; BSE explicitly writes `undefined`; Moneycontrol and Chittorgarh never assigned a `sector` key anywhere in their scrapers. T-455 narrowed the matrix to `['ADMIN']` only (correctly refusing to list a source that could never deliver), but that left the field permanently empty absent a manual edit.
first_seen: round-7 P3-1, issue #242 (T-455); re-opened as issue #394 (owner decision 5, 2026-09-08)
fix_prs:
T-507 (this PR): found the Chittorgarh per-IPO detail page DOES carry the sector — not as a labelled row like other fields, but as the heading of the page's 'recently listed peers' table (`

Recently Listed IPOs in

`), verified against two real captured pages (Ather Energy -> Automobiles, Vikran Engineering -> Specialty Chemicals). Added `extractSectorFromDetailHtml` (chittorgarh-detail-fields.ts), a live per-IPO visit (`chittorgarh-sector-visitor.ts`, called from `runChittorgarhScraper()`, current-fiscal-year discovery only for cost), a one-time historical backfill tool (`backfill-sector-chittorgarh.ts`, full fiscal-year sweep), and re-added CHITTORGARH to the matrix (`sector: ['ADMIN', 'CHITTORGARH']`). Also found and fixed a URL-resolution bug in the process: a slug-only detail URL guess (no numeric report id) 404s live for every company tried, including the PR's own fixture source (Ather Energy) — `chittorgarh-detail-url-resolver.ts` resolves slug+id from Chittorgarh's own report-82 discovery feed instead of guessing.
detection_check: `scripts/audit-ipo-coverage.mjs` CORE ipos COLUMN FILL-RATE section reports `sector` non-null-AND-non-empty % nightly (report mode, not `--gate`-blocking — the field fills in gradually as the live cycle rotates through the current fiscal year, and the historical backfill is a separate manual run, so a hard threshold right after deploy would false-positive on day one). T-507 also fixed a masking bug in this same check: it previously counted `sector = ''` as filled (`IS NOT NULL` alone), which would have hidden this exact regression forever — now excludes empty string for `sector`/`symbol`/`registrar`/`company_description`.
status: unguarded (dashboard-only; no `--gate` threshold exists for `sector` specifically — same rationale as the sibling `issue_type` fill-rate row)
